Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Teresa Estrada DBA City of Inglewood, Parks Recreation Community Services
  Department to host a STEM Fest Event at 700 Warren Lane, Edward Vincent Park,
  on Saturday, April 09, 2022, from 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. (Activity No.00340861)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Heather Pentecost DBA Linc Housing to host a Fairview Heights Apartment Grand
  Opening Event at 923 E. Redondo Blvd., Fairview Heights Apartments, on Thursday,
  April 14, 2022, from 12:30 p.m. – 2:30 p.m. (Activity No.00340933)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Aisha L. Thompson DBA City of Inglewood, City Clerk’s Office to host a City’s Clerks
  Annual Voter Registration Day Event on Market St., Public Property, on Saturday,
  September 17, 2022, from 12:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Activity No.00340911)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
